messages:
elaine: quick sync Acme pilot signed LOE asking for SSO + auto provisioning. they want a hard pilot week but we only have bandwidth for a slim pilot.

devin: two paths: SAML-only pilot + ops-assisted provisioning (fast), or delay and ship SAML+SCIM auto-provisioning (slower). engineering: SCIM minimal ~3w.

omar: compliance note: audit logs required for provisioning events. adding basic logging is ~2d.

sandra: customer asks: they need seats populated within 48h after invite. manual provisioning may break that SLA if ops is slow.

chris: ops workaround is feasible for first cohort: we'll run an onboarding script and track time to completion. reduces eng lift.

jonah: timeline math: SAML-only + ops -> pilot in ~2w, automation for v1 in +6w. SAML+SCIM -> pilot in ~5w.

devin: risk callout: shipping minimal SCIM without full e2e increases support load. prefer to put it in v1 backlog.

omar: QA suggests staged rollout (one team at a time) to limit blast radius.

elaine: proposal: SAML-only pilot, ops-assisted onboarding, commit to SCIM+audit logs for v1. Milestones: pilot start +2w, v1 GA +8w.

chris: i'll own runbook & oncall rota for 4w and publish in #support.

sandra: i'll notify Acme and confirm they accept manual onboarding for pilot.

devin: i'll update PRD and add SCIM to v1 backlog; feature-flag SAML for quick rollback.

omar: QA will prepare staged rollout plan and audit validations.

elaine: action items: sandra update Acme today; chris publish runbook in 48h; devin update PRD by EOD; calendar-bot: create milestone check-in Friday 10am.

calendar-bot: "Event created: Pilot scope check-in Friday 10:00"

elaine: marking resolved for now unless Acme insists on automation before pilot start. :thumbsup:
